identity.title: [v0.92.1][runtime][observatory] Wire trusted Observatory origin into CSM launch config

values.task_boundary: Exactly the omitted CSM trusted-origin wiring, config-owned HTML Runtime API host trust, the missing CORS behavior on the Runtime health endpoint consumed by the Observatory, executable proof, and bounded live validation.
deliverables: Executable valid and invalid CSM configuration tests
Config-owned HTML Observatory trusted Runtime API host
Live browser connection proof from localhost:8000 and the trusted port-8765 Observatory
Fresh exact-head review and truthful PR
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The optional public origin is an exact HTTPS DNS host with an optional port in 1..65535.
AC-2: Paths, queries, fragments, credentials, wildcards, malformed ports, out-of-range ports, and canonical duplicates fail before config replacement.
AC-3: Generated init covers empty, localhost-only, public-only, and combined origin sets deterministically.
AC-4: /v1/health returns exact configured-origin CORS headers and rejects unconfigured browser origins consistently with /v1/ready and /v1/observatory.
AC-5: The HTML Observatory default Runtime API base and trusted host come from runtime-v3.config.json, accept the configured Wuji HTTPS host, and reject arbitrary hosts.
AC-6: TLS key, certificate, bind, continuity, and unrelated CSM authority remain unchanged.
AC-7: Executable focused tests, shell syntax, diff hygiene, Runtime CORS/WSS tests, HTML Observatory security tests, and live Wuji browser/TLS/CORS probes pass.
AC-8: Fresh exact-head review has zero actionable findings and publication truth closes only issue #550.
dependencies: HOT-01 #510 remains separately owned for dynamic reload
non_goals: Router, DNS, ACM, Caddy, or certificate issuance changes
